metadata.name: Ritualist Class Tree
metadata.description: Single continuous web. The Path of Binding runs up the centre and is what fills Fervour from what you command. Dominion lower-left, The Swarm upper-left, Warded upper-right, The Long Game lower-right. Keystones sit at the far end of each limb and need full investment in their parent. The four pact capstones are the 25/50/100/200 point tiers and stand apart from the web.

data.name: Fervour
data.description: Your minions generate Fervour: 1 per second for each minion you have, and 5 when one of them dies. While you have this, Fervour does not decay, so what you hold is held until you spend it or reserve it.

data.name: The Third Pact
data.description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: Shared Ruin

options.name: Standing Apart
options.description: You take 25% less damage from enemies more than 6 metres away from you.

data.name: The Final Pact
data.description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent.

options.name: A Second Self
options.description: One thrall becomes your equal: it has your Maximum Health, your Spell Damage and your Area of Effect, and reserves 60 Fervour rather than 30.

options.name: Hollow Crown
options.description: Each minion you have grants you 4% more damage and 4% increased Maximum Energy Shield.

options.name: Chorus
options.description: Your minions repeat each skill you cast, dealing 30% of its damage.
